content: If UdpNmComUserDataSupport is enabled and NM - PDU is not configured for triggered transmission in SoAd ( SoAdBswModules/SoAdIfTriggerTransmit = FALSE ), the UdpNm shall collect the NM User Data from the referenced NM I - PDU by calling PduR_UdpNmTriggerTransmit and combine the user data with the further NM bytes each time before it requests the transmission of the corresponding NM message.
